summary: Franco-Nevada Corporation filed a routine Form 6-K containing a news release announcing it will report third quarter 2026 results after market close on November 11, 2026, with a conference call and webcast on November 12, 2026 at 8:00 am ET. The filing provides dial-in details and replay information available until November 19. No special-situation transaction, price, stake, recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanics are disclosed. It is a scheduling notice only; the risk-arb angle is nil, with the takeaway being normal quarterly reporting cadence for the royalty and streaming company.
